deploy-bot: :rotating_light: pipeline failed on master after merge by maya — commit 9f3c2a1 (PR #3421). failed step: integration-tests · allocator-shard-assert
maya: ah, that's mine — merged that change ~15m ago, sorry.
sam: which test exactly?
deploy-bot: failing test: TestKVShardRebalance. stdout snippet: "panic: alloc: shard index out of range"
kai: can anyone paste the failing step logs? link: https://ci.internal/runs/4987650001/logs (shortlink)
maya: pasted minimal log: ```
--- FAIL: TestKVShardRebalance (0.24s)
    shard_test.go:87: expected 3 shards, got 0
    goroutine 23 [running]:
```
lee: hmm looks like a race with allocator init on CUDA nodes — I saw similar once with async-init. was this change touching init ordering?
maya: just moves init earlier in startup path, didn't touch allocator.
sam: ok first triage: try quick rerun on cpu-only matrix to rule out fluke, then gpu. @deploy-bot can you rerun matrix cpu-only?
deploy-bot: accepted. rerun queued: `ci rerun --matrix=cpu` (run id 4987650002).
oncall-bot: escalation policy: if pipeline stays red for >30m ping oncall team. currently 2m elapsed.
lee: if cpu pass and gpu fail, likely kernel/driver schedule. can someone trigger a gpu rerun with DEBUG_ALLOC=1 env? that dumps allocator traces.
sam: I can kick that off after cpu result. also I'll start a quick bisect to find the first bad commit in the merge window. give me owner tags to ping.
maya: owners: @maya (my PR), @storage-team for allocator.
sam: starting bisect: `ci bisect --since=4987600000 --until=4987650001 --test=TestKVShardRebalance` — will report back with findings.
deploy-bot: cpu-only run (4987650002) passed all stages.
lee: cpu green, so likely gpu-specific. proceed with DEBUG_ALLOC run.
sam: kicked gpu-debug run (4987650003) and bisect in progress. first bad commit candidate: 9f3c2a1 (maya's), but bisect still checking older merges.
maya: if it's my change and repros on gpu, I can revert fast if needed.
deploy-bot: gpu-debug run failed with same panic and allocator trace: ```alloc: shard init race at shard_manager.go:54```
sam: bisect narrowed to 9e8b4f7 -> 9f3c2a1 (maya) as introduce point.
maya: ack. reverting PR now: `/revert PR 3421`
deploy-bot: revert queued, will create a revert PR and run full pipeline.
lee: :thumbsup: good call. after revert lands, we should add a targeted unit test for early-init ordering.
oncall-bot: pipeline still red (total elapsed 18m). will escalate if >30m.
maya: thanks all — I'll open a bug and link the debug logs and the revert once CI passes.
sam: keeping monitor on bisect and revert. update when revert PR builds. :eyes:
